verdict.rationale: Codegen agents work through PRs/branches/commits which are inherently versioned and reviewable (codegen-docs-4, codegen-docs-20, codegen-docs-24), and agent runs can be paused/resumed or banned (codegen-docs-34, codegen-docs-35), giving some control over in-flight automations. However there is no explicit documentation of versioning the automation/agent configuration itself, a review workflow for automations before they run, or a rollback mechanism to revert an automation to a prior version. Missing for 10: explicit automation/config versioning, an automation-specific review/approval flow, and a documented rollback feature for agent configurations.
